facts.summary: A beneficiary photo may be updated through the applicable State or Union Territory PDS process when the concerned system provides a photo-update facility.
purpose: Keep beneficiary records up to date.
Maintain an accurate beneficiary profile where a photograph is part of the applicable PDS record.
how_to_update: Use the official PDS portal if the State/UT provides an online photo-update facility.
Visit the designated Food and Civil Supplies or PDS office if an offline update is required.
Submit the photograph and other information requested by the applicable system.
Complete any identity or beneficiary verification required by the concerned authority.
requirements: Existing beneficiary or ration-card information may be required.
A photograph meeting the applicable system requirements may be required.
Additional identity or verification information may be required according to State/UT procedures.
facts.online_update: Online photo-update availability depends on the concerned State or Union Territory PDS system.
facts.verification: The concerned State/UT may require beneficiary or identity verification before accepting a photo update.
failed_update: Check that the photograph meets the requirements of the applicable system.
Verify that the submitted beneficiary information is correct.
If online updating is unavailable or unsuccessful, follow the designated offline procedure or contact the concerned PDS authority.
facts.state_specific: The availability of photo updates, photograph requirements, verification process and update procedure can differ between States and Union Territories.
facts.privacy: Photographs and beneficiary information should only be submitted through official government portals, designated offices or authorized PDS facilities.
important_notes: Do not assume that every State/UT allows beneficiaries to update their photo online.
Do not invent specific photograph dimensions or file-size requirements without State/UT-specific information.
Photo updating is different from updating a mobile number or address.
Follow the requirements shown by the applicable official PDS system.

faqs.question: Can I update my photo on my ration card?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary photo may be updated if the applicable State/UT PDS system provides a photo-update facility.

faqs.question: How can I change my ration card photo?
faqs.answer: Follow the photo-update process provided by your State/UT PDS authority, either through its official portal where available or through the designated PDS/Food and Civil Supplies office.

faqs.question: Can I update my ration card photo online?
faqs.answer: Online photo-update availability depends on the concerned State or Union Territory PDS system.

faqs.question: Do I need verification to update my photo?
faqs.answer: The concerned State/UT may require beneficiary or identity verification before accepting a photo update.

faqs.question: What photo size is required?
faqs.answer: The applicable photograph format, dimensions and file requirements depend on the State/UT PDS system. They should be confirmed through the official system.

organizations: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
Concerned State or Union Territory Food and Civil Supplies Authority
